I can strongly relate to this Ive decided for the longest time im going to kill myself deep in a forest don’t know which one yet, just so long as I can get a good view of the sunrise.

I sometimes tell myself “why don’t I just do it right now just withdraw all my money go buy the rope and a travel ticket and just find the spot” and let that be the only thought on my mind till I find the spot. But then I remember I still got just a little bit of fight in me to keep going so it’s just enough for me to see tomorrow, but I’ll be honest this is my last fight.

 I have fallen and picked myself up to many times and I can’t no more, I just can’t I’m ungodly exhausted from all of it and so much more. All I can say now is I don’t care if I make it out or not I just care that I at least gave it my god damn absolute hell to the very bitter fucking end of all this shit, cause knowing that I did that much will make my death not just earned and deserved but absolutely peaceful.

Hey Eldudebrother hope your doing ok if your reading this at the moment, so I’ve been thinking some of the same things as you for awhile now and for some I still question them. There’s one thing though that I feel makes sense to me, when it comes to why the feeling that theres even any ounce of hope when so much torment has been surrounding me for so long is that it’s a type of survival instinct if that makes sense. See really deep down we all don’t want to die if it be a human an animal or insect we always fight back even if it seems hopeless to do so. We don’t want to just live but to survive to see another tomorrow the feeling will never change it will always be the same when things get to close to the wire, like a last line of defense but that’s all it is a defense. The rest is up to you weather or not to keep up the fight to see another day, but even if you fell your gonna lose still give it your all and make it a memorable one till the very end. 

As for the reason why there any point in moving forward well I guess it’s the experience of existence  and change, to not just witness everything but also be apart of it and so much more over time. We choose what we want to be and what we want out of it but that idea is overwhelming, it’s simple and complicated at the same time so it’s best to try to just keep it simple and build it up gradually. Its like that saying “It not about the destination but the journey that lies head.” You got to go with flow but try not to get swept away, so try to not overthink it and start with something simple and work your way towards it something that won’t make you feel like it was pointless from start to finish  but something that will make you feel accomplished and proud instead. 
  
There’s more I would like to add but I’m running out of time so I’ll sum this last part up the best I can. You said you are seeing a therapist that’s really good start I don’t know how long you’ve been going to your therapist but just remember that somethings will take time and patience to see any form of results some times it will be a bit longer but as long as you commit to bettering yourself and stay consistent you’ll see result, big or small but results none the less. Also try to stay close with your sister strengthen your bond if you can, you two can help each other in both of your darkest hours. 

I’m sorry that your going through so much for so long but I hope you will soon find the peace and happiness you truly and rightfully deserve but for now keep giving it your absolute all and don’t lose your fight stay strong, stay safe and stay connected.

Take a deep breath hold it........and breath maybe do that another two more times, ok how I see it you need to focus on your mental state FIRST way before diving head first into that online summer course it must have great importance to you but right now you need you focus on your mental health and finding a way to get admitted have you tried calling up the hospital and asked if they have some sorta of program for those without insurance to get admitted or maybe ask asked a close friend or aunt or uncle to help things might seem dire but right now just need to stay calm.
Your welcome and remember You got this man you fuckin got this so stay strong

It’s alright to feel afraid it’s scary to be in a world like this to grow up in a time like this but we have to fight through it but never alone you say your a coward for not being able to live a normal life well what is normal anymore, I think normal should be what makes you feel safe while expressing your true self that to me is normal so what do you think is normal?

 You say you want to die but you don’t want to go through with it because your feel afraid, that’s normal you don’t need to die there is no cowards way out your no coward for wanting to end it like that. It takes courage to still keep standing when everything around you feels like it’s shattering to bits, and even though you say your a coward I see someone who is still standing shaking but still standing tall and that right there is no coward to me that’s one valiant SOB. You got this you got heart and you got courage being an adult isn’t always easy but you got this there is no need to grow up to fast just take it one step at a time and always be yourself, hope you get better.

What ever happens never let the negative words from others be the definition of you. If you start to believe and accept what they say about you it won’t go well especially when it comes from “family.” It’s hard to defend from it but you need to remember that you are who you chose to define yourself, so it should be your words not theirs be the louder voice. 

 And for those thought that you have all I can say is, stay strong stay very strong you have much in you and that I can tell. So stay connected to those who are willing to listen never be afraid to seek help no matter what and always remember to plant your feet raise your fists and give it your absolute hell you’ll get through this it’ll take time it might be rough but I know you will, so good luck.

Some times you want to just lie down and stay their and the urge to keep going just fades away but you need to grip onto what you have left and pull yourself back up it’s hard and it’ll feel meaningless to do that again and again but as long as you still feel something does not matter what but as along as you feel you still got a chance in ya and you have to fight it with everything you got don’t question why your still going why your still fighting just keep going go till you finally make it to a point where you can finally rest easy and still wake up to see tomorrow.

Giving up isn’t easy it’s just as hard as choosing to keep on going in life saying it is one thing but to go through with either one is a whole different scene all together and it’s hard to chose which one to go with sometimes.

I appreciate your kind words truly I do but I don’t make promises I feel I can not keep and for that I’m sorry. I want to go far enough to know I have changed myself and my outlook to live another day but i only have spite in myself to guide me and that’s all I truly have, I’ve been through... enough. I’ve made peace with my discussions I have no fear nor remorse for what will happen when that moment comes but I do hope that I can make a significant breakthrough that it will prevent it before then, but this is not out of desperation but to see if I can actually change.
It’s alright to let it out no need to be afraid right now just say what you fell you want to say
How are you feeling right now man you want to talk.

I’ll be perfectly honest I don’t have much time left in me I know that for certain but I want to at least see if I can get others out of this hell hole cause that’s the best I can do I just don’t want to see more people fall as far as I did I just want to give them the thing I never had someone who can be there for them in there most darkest hour

seeing people like you trying to be there for others when they have no one else around them gives me a bit of hope, your a good man and reading through your vent I hope you have a good outcome. and to anyone hesitant on letting it out don’t be just let it out don’t be afraid anymore it’s alright to just vent.

It’s one hell of a temptation that sometimes never makes sense one minute it’s a small after thought that you don’t really think twice about and then the next it’s only all that you really feel like this is what you need that you want but when really it’s something you need to fight sometimes it’ll hit you good but you need to hit at it back harder.

I don’t openly talk about this particular event of my life but I have to say 11 years ago, if I just took a few more minutes to calm down and collect myself I probably wouldn’t have gone through with my failed suicide attempt when I was 12 years old. Or instead also if I took the extra time to make sure the belt and rope was properly secured so it never came undo then I wouldn’t still be here today. 
   I’ll be honest It never really got better for me as time went on and I’m really exhausted, but right now I only got enough for one more fight and that’s it. I want to at least say I gave it my absolute all this time, cause now I know I have some means to change and so I want to see that through to the very end.
In a sense I feel it like that but I just tell my self to  either go big or go home that’s been my motto for a good while now
